answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed temporal half-life, so influence earned in a quill-like burst quickly fades; identities must provide sustained, reciprocal honest service across the horizon to retain weight. In the EigenTrust matrix, freshly spawned Sybil nodes have few trusted incoming paths and near-zero eigenvector centrality. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot amplify absent trust, leaving them unable to pass consensus as they wander into the network.
